title: Extract a helper
skill: Name the helper, its contract and its callers

good: Create shop/validators.py with require_positive(name, value): if value is a bool, not an int/float, not math.isfinite, or <= 0, raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a positive number, got {value!r}"); else return value. In shop/pricing.py (line_total: price then qty), shop/inventory.py (restock: qty) and shop/shipping.py (shipping_cost: weight_kg), add from shop.validators import require_positive, call require_positive("<param name>", <param>), and delete the old inline checks completely. Change nothing else. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: The positive-number check is copied in three modules. Extract it into a helper.
